name: tryout
description: Tryout: real employer tasks become verified experience. UNHack26 prototype with two websites (students + employers) on one live API.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix apps/student install && npm --prefix apps/employer install
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,student,employer -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix apps/student run dev" "npm --prefix apps/employer run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server run check-grader && npm --prefix apps/student run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/employer run typecheck && npx -y tsx shared/content/check.ts
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/student run build && npm --prefix apps/employer run build
